Nipa to host Bijoy Dibosh TV Program
2015-12-05T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/showbiz/deshi-grapevine/nipa-host-bijoy-dibosh-tv-program-182389

Shameem Ara Nipa will host a 50-minute special on Bijoy Dibosh called "Bijoy Chondogatha" which she will also script and direct. It will be broadcasted on Bangladesh Television as part of their Bijoy Dibosh celebrations.

She says that she loves making dance shows for Bijoy Dibosh as it provides a medium to bring out something beautiful for the audience. She also said that it delivers something new to the younger audience which peaks her interest in directing such recitals.
